## Behavior and architecture

Describe the concrete problem, resulting behavior, owning packages, and API changes.

## Decisions for review

List predictor definitions, ambiguity defaults, copy changes, and proposed specification corrections. Explain alternatives and rationale.

## Testing

Give exact commands and label each result PASS, FAIL, or NOT RUN. Distinguish local tests, hosted CI, and device acceptance.

## Rollback

Describe how to reverse the change while preserving immutable raw data and compatibility.
